<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input file
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Get indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}
kept_indicators = []

for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
    missing_counts[col] = missing_count
    missing_rates[col] = missing_rate
    if missing_rate <= 0.30:
        kept_indicators.append(col)

# Create missingness report
report_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_cols,
    'missing_count': [missing_counts[col] for col in indicator_cols],
    'missing_rate': [missing_rates[col] for col in indicator_cols],
    'kept': [col in kept_indicators for col in indicator_cols]
})

# Save missingness report
report_path = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
report_df.to_csv(report_path, index=False)

# Create selected matrix with kept indicators only
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]

# Save selected matrix
selected_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
selected_df.to_csv(selected_path, index=False)

print(f"Processed {len(indicator_cols)} indicators")
print(f"Kept {len(kept_indicators)} indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30")
</solution_file>
